changes.summary: Bound this recipe to the evidence-backed model capability authority without changing runtime behavior.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: The upstream revision changes README metadata only; model weights, configuration, tokenizer, runtime image, and serving arguments remain byte-identical. Existing runtime containers do not require a rebuild, while the catalog now points at the current immutable source revision.
changes.summary: Pinned the current immutable Poolside Laguna S 2.1 NVFP4 snapshot at 826aacdf.

changes.details: Laguna weights are mounted after the image is built and retain exact Poolside repository, revision, license, and attribution metadata in the model and recipe contracts. The image source, revision, and license labels now bind its Apache-2.0 vLLM payload instead of misidentifying the external model as image source code.
changes.summary: Corrected OCI labels to identify the vLLM runtime actually baked into the image.

changes.details: Upstream 826aacdf differs from the complete immutable 64734b3a snapshot only in README.md; all model, tokenizer, configuration, and weight payloads remain byte-identical. Physical single-Spark memory and runtime acceptance are still required.
changes.summary: Confirmed the newer upstream head changes documentation only.
Completed the immutable checkpoint manifest and corrected its snapshot and staging sizes.
Declared the GB10 CUDA architecture and bounded cold FlashInfer JIT concurrency.
Routed non-root vLLM caches to the writable outputs mount.

changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.
changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Laguna S 2.1 NVFP4 vLLM single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
